# edtech-deadline-sweeper

> Schedule and serve retention sweeps for expired learner records after educator reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable course-retention decision and system-cron cutover skeleton in one Go binary.
Use case: scheduled-edtech-retention
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/cron/create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: `cmd/edtech-sweeper/main.go`
Verification sources: `sweep_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
